title: A4F Tech Web Localization
description: The contributor localized and optimized the A4F-Tech commercial website to align with German B2B buyer expectations and cloud architecture capabilities involving Supabase Realtime. They secured the platform against regulatory risks by implementing GDPR-compliant privacy policies, removing external Google Fonts tracking, and adding a legally required Impressum. These efforts successfully transformed the site from a developer-focused placeholder into a compliant, professional B2B marketing asset.
